## Brand

Corporate user-interface design focuses on professionalism, consistency, and
brand alignment. It uses minimalist layouts, structured grids, and AI-driven
personalization.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: enterprise, premium
- Typography scale: desktop-first expressive scale | Fonts: primary=Open Sans,
  display=Poppins, mono=IBM Plex Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600,
  700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#3B82F6, secondary=#8B5CF6, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 8pt baseline grid

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful, clear, professional, action-oriented,
  low-jargon.

## Design intent

Professional, brand-aligned design with structured grids, minimalist layouts,
and consistent enterprise patterns.
